note: 인쇄물 템플릿이 쓰는 생성 그림. 이 파일이 원본이고, scripts/print-art.mjs 가 이것만 보고 그림을 만듭니다. width/height/bytes 는 만든 뒤 스크립트가 적어 넣습니다. 자세한 규칙은 docs/print-templates.md.
suffix: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signage. Leave generous empty space for typography. Clean edges, no border, no frame, full-bleed composition. Print quality, natural colours, no oversaturation.

art.note: 카페 — 원두와 드리퍼가 놓인 나무 상판
art.prompt: Overhead photograph of a wooden cafe counter in warm morning light: a ceramic dripper, scattered roasted coffee beans, a folded linen cloth. Shallow depth of field, muted warm palette, upper half almost empty.

Flat vector illustration of stacked books, pencils and a ruler arranged along the bottom edge, geometric shapes, three colours only (deep navy, warm cream, muted coral), thick simple forms, no outlines, generous empty cream space above.

Photograph of a bright empty pilates studio filling the entire frame: pale oak floor, a wooden reformer bed with leather straps in the lower right corner, a tall window casting long morning light across the floor, warm beige and soft grey, calm and minimal, the upper half an empty wall. Edge to edge photograph, no frame, no border, no mockup.

Watercolour painted directly onto the entire frame: seasonal vegetables — spring onion, napa cabbage, red pepper, garlic — massed along the bottom edge, soft bleeding edges, the paint runs off the bottom and both side edges, the upper two thirds plain warm white. Edge to edge artwork, no paper sheet, no frame, no drop shadow, no border.
Flat scan of warm tan kraft paper, fine fibre speckles, even soft lighting, no shadows, no objects, subtle vignette at the very edges only.
Minimal composition of two overlapping soft arcs in dusty pink and pale sand on an off-white field, matte finish, no gradient banding, shapes confined to the left third, rest empty.
Cinematic photograph of a dark concert hall interior, deep teal shadow, one warm spotlight pooling on an empty stage at the lower third, heavy film grain, everything above dissolving into black.

Flat vector illustration of a night market: paper lanterns, striped awnings and simple rooftops along the bottom quarter, silkscreen texture, four flat colours (ink navy, warm yellow, coral, cream), no outlines, wide empty sky above.

Flat graphic filling the entire frame: one large pale blue circle placed low and to the right, one thin horizontal band of soft mint crossing beneath it, plain white everywhere else, matte flat colour, no gradient. Edge to edge artwork, no frame, no mockup, no shadow, no paper sheet, no border.

art.note: 종교·단체 행사 — 창으로 드는 빛 수채화
art.prompt: Watercolour wash filling the entire frame: warm light falling through a tall arched window onto pale stone, dusty gold and warm grey, the wash runs off all four edges, the upper area left almost white, paper grain visible. Edge to edge artwork, no paper sheet, no frame, no border, no vignette, no figures.

art.note: 모집 공고 — 거친 종이와 옅은 격자
art.prompt: Close photograph of coarse recycled paper in warm off-white, faint printed grid lines showing through, uneven fibre texture, even flat lighting, no objects.

Wide photograph of celebratory ribbons and fresh flowers massed along the left edge against a deep crimson wall, soft studio light, rich saturated red, the right two thirds an even uninterrupted wall.

Wide photograph of a steaming Korean stew in an earthenware pot on a dark wooden table, rising steam, warm side light, deep browns and reds, dish placed at the far right, the left half dark and empty.

Bold minimal composition: three thick diagonal bands in saffron yellow, off-black and white sweeping across the left quarter of a wide field, hard flat edges, high contrast, remainder a single flat off-black plane.
Vertical photograph looking up at a modern residential building against a clear pale sky, clean concrete and glass, soft afternoon light, building occupying the lower third, wide empty sky above.
Vertical watercolour of pale peonies and eucalyptus trailing down the right edge, dusty rose and sage on white paper, soft bleeding edges, paper grain, the left two thirds untouched white.
Vertical minimal composition: one enormous soft arc of deep indigo rising from the bottom edge over a pale grey field, matte flat colour, no gradient banding, upper half completely empty.

Vertical photograph of a bright clinic waiting area corner, white wall, pale wood bench, one potted monstera leaf entering from the lower left, soft diffused morning light, most of the frame is empty white wall.
Close photograph of natural ivory linen cloth, fine even weave, soft raking light from the top left, no folds crossing the centre, warm neutral tone.
Dark walnut wood surface photographed straight on, fine straight grain, warm low light falling from the top left, deep brown, no objects, no reflections.

Loose watercolour band of Korean ingredients across the top quarter: dried red pepper, garlic, sesame leaves, soft bleeding edges on warm white paper, muted red and green, the rest of the page left white.

Flat vector illustration of coffee tools in a row along the bottom: moka pot, dripper, scale, cup, thick simple geometric forms, three colours only (espresso brown, cream, muted teal), no outlines, generous cream space above.
Dark charcoal marble slab photographed straight on, subtle pale veining, matte surface, even soft light, no objects, no reflections, deep neutral tone.
